note: Reverie stated deviations, BRIEF.md 'Stated deviations' and 'RTPC integration rules': the user asked for a themed, living atmosphere behind every character screen. Inside src/theme/** (and its stylesheet src/styles/theme.css) gradients, glow, blur and translucent layers ARE the product. Only the chat header pills, the composer and the tab bar may blur what is behind them (backdrop-filter at --blur-ui, 12px max), for legibility over moving particles. The desktop phone bezel uses --radius-48: a device mockup, not UI, and no check here grades radii. Nothing else gets glass, glow or gradients, except the dark legibility scrim under type on a photo (swipe card, profile hero), after the brief's Tinder reference.

overrides.reason: The atmosphere engine and its overlays: scene plates, light washes, fog, god-rays and glows are each world's art (celestial and neon worlds use violet light by design).
The three surfaces the blur budget allows: header pills, composer and tab bar float over a canvas that redraws every frame and blur at --blur-ui so their labels stay legible.
